blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on general video understanding benchmarks, yet their ability to reason about participant roles in aggressive interactions remains largely unexplored. Existing violence and crime datasets primarily evaluate whether aggression occurs, without testing whether models can identify who performed the action, who received it, and how participants are related within the scene. To address this gap, we introduce A$^3$Bench, a benchmark to study aggressive action and association in videos. The benchmark evaluates whether models can jointly recognize aggressive actions, distinguish aggressors from victims and bystanders, and correctly bind actions to participants under challenging distractor settings. We benchmark 17 multimodal models and find that they struggle substantially on fine-grained aggressive-scene understanding. Performance degrades consistently as reasoning complexity increases, with models frequently confusing aggressors with victims or bystanders, revealing a systematic failure in role-action association rather than coarse aggression recognition alone. We further observe that increasing model scale or generic reasoning models experience limited improvement. Finally, we explore a simple role-graph prompting strategy that encourages structured reasoning over participant interactions, leading to improvements in compositional reasoning. Our findings highlight that reliable aggressive-scene understanding remains a major challenge for current MLLMs and motivate future research on role-aware video reasoning beyond coarse violence detection. Code and dataset: https://github.com/austincbaker/A3Bench.
blocks.zh: 近期的多式联运大型语言模型在一般视频理解基准上取得了强劲的性能,然而,它们就参与者在积极互动中的作用提出理由的能力仍然基本上没有得到探讨。 现有的暴力和犯罪数据集主要评价是否发生侵略,而没有检验模型是否能够确定实施行动的人、接受行动的人以及参与者在现场内部的关系。 为了弥补这一差距,我们采用了A^3 Bench,这是研究侵略行动和视频中的关联的基准。 该基准评价模型是否能够共同识别侵略行动,将侵略者与受害者和旁观者区别开来,并在具有挑战性的分散注意力环境下将行动正确约束给参与者。 我们以17种多式联运模式为基准,发现它们在精细的侵略性理解上挣扎。 随着推理复杂性的提高,性能持续下降,模式往往将攻击者与受害者或旁观者混为一谈,暴露出角色行动联系的系统性失败,而不仅仅是粗糙的侵略承认。 我们进一步注意到,模型规模或通用推理模型不断增长,但改进有限。 最后,我们探索一种简单的角色图激励战略,鼓励对参与者互动进行结构化推理,从而改进组成推理。 我们的调查结果强调,可靠的正面理解仍然是当前MLLM的一大挑战,并激励今后在粗糙的暴力探测之外,对角色意识视频推理进行研究。 代码和数据集:https://github.com/austincbaker/A3 Bench.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have demonstrated strong performance on video understanding tasks, including action recognition Carreira and Zisserman (2017) ; Goyal et al. (2017) ; Soomro et al. (2012) ; Kuehne et al. (2011) ; Heilbron et al. (2015) , temporal event localization, and video question answering Li et al. (2024) ; Liu et al. (2024b) ; Yue et al. (2024) . Existing action datasets have been highly effective in evaluating models across a wide range of everyday activities, sports actions Li et al. (2021) ; Shao et al. (2020) , human-object interactions Sigurdsson et al. (2016) ; Ji et al. (2020) , and complex temporal events Monfort et al. (2020) ; Yeung et al. (2018) . While these tasks are important for general video understanding, reliable real-world systems must also recognize safety-critical behaviors, including physical altercations or threatening interactions. However, understanding aggression requires more than detecting that a violent or harmful action has occurred. In practical settings such as security, public safety monitoring, school safety, sports analysis, and online video moderation, it is often not enough to recognize what is happening; it is also necessary to understand how each person in the scene is involved. Without role-aware reasoning, a system may correctly classify a scene as aggressive while still producing an incorrect or harmful interpretation.
blocks.zh: 近期的多式大型语言模型在视频理解任务上表现出了很强的表现,包括行动识别Carreira和Zisserman(2017年);Goyal等(2017年);Soomro等(2012年);Kuehne等(2011年);Heilbron等(2015年);时间事件本地化;视频问题回答Li等(2024年);Liu等(2024年); 岳等 (2024) (中文(简体) ). 现有行动数据集在评价各种日常活动模式、Li等(2021年)、Shao等(2020年)、人与物相互作用方面非常有效。 Sigurdsson等(2016年);Ji等(2020年),以及复杂的时间事件 Monfort等 (2020年); Yeung等 (2018年). 虽然这些任务对于一般的视频理解很重要,但可靠的现实世界系统也必须识别安全关键行为,包括物理相争或威胁性互动. 然而,理解侵略不仅仅要求发现发生了暴力或有害行动。 在诸如安全、公共安全监测、学校安全、体育分析和在线视频节制等实际环境下,往往不足以认识正在发生的事情;还必须了解现场每个人是如何参与的。 没有角色意识的推理,一个系统可能正确地将一个场景归类为攻击性,同时仍然产生不正确或有害的解释.

blocks.en: Prior work has studied aggressive actions through crime detection Sultani et al. (2018) ; An et al. (2025) , violence detection Wu et al. (2020) ; Ali et al. (2025c) ; Nievas et al. (2011) ; Hassner et al. (2012) ; Cheng et al. (2021) ; Kollias et al. (2025) ; Mahi et al. (2024) , and incident understanding datasets Ali et al. (2025b) ; Luo et al. (2017) . Some provide multiple aggressive action categories, while others formulate the task as binary classification, such as normal vs. anomalous or violent vs. non-violent. These resources have advanced the study of abnormal and dangerous events, but they typically evaluate only whether aggression is present. They often do not require reasoning about the individuals involved in the scene, including who initiates the action, or who is affected by it. In particular, existing evaluations rarely test whether an aggressive action can be bound to the correct actor, whether aggressors can be distinguished from victims and bystanders, or whether multi-person interactions can be resolved. This limitation can reward models that rely on contextual shortcuts, scene priors, or coarse motion cues, rather than learning the semantic relationships between people, actions, and roles. This necessitates a more fine-grained capability: aggressive action and association , where the goal is not only to recognize an aggressive behavior, but also to associate it with the correct participant roles.
blocks.zh: 先前的工作通过犯罪侦查Sultani等(2018年)、An等(2025年)、暴力侦查Wu等(2020年)、Ali等(2025年c),Nievas等(2011年)、Hassner等(2012年)、Cheng等(2021年)、Kollias等(2025年)、Mahi等(2024年)以及事件理解数据集Ali等(2025年b),Luo等(2017年)。 有的提供了多类攻击性行动类别,有的则将任务设定为二进制分类,如普通对异常或暴力对非暴力. 这些资源推动了对异常和危险事件的研究,但它们通常只评估是否存在侵略。 他们往往不要求对参与现场的个人进行推理,包括谁发起行动,或谁受到行动的影响。 特别是,现有的评价很少检验侵略行动能否与正确的行为者相接,侵略者能否与受害者和旁观者区分开来,或者多人互动能否被解决. 这种限制可以奖励依赖背景快捷键,场景前传,或粗糙运动提示的模型,而不是学习人,行动和角色之间的语义关系. 这就需要一种更精细的能力:侵略行动和联合,目标不仅是承认一种侵略行为,而且还要把它与正确的参与者角色联系起来。

blocks.en: To address this, we introduce A 3 Bench, a benchmark for evaluating aggressive action and association (A 3 ) in MLLMs. A 3 Bench contains 2,683 video clips and 15,004 question-answer pairs that move beyond coarse aggression recognition to evaluate role-aware reasoning in aggressive scenes. Rather than asking only whether aggression occurs, the benchmark probes models on aggressive actions and participant-role associations, including aggressors, victims, and bystanders. These questions require models to distinguish individuals, interpret interactions, and correctly bind actions to participants. By focusing on fine-grained role-action reasoning, A 3 Bench provides a challenging testbed for assessing whether current MLLMs can reliably understand aggressive scenes.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这一问题,我们引入了三席制,这是在MLLMs中评价积极行动和关联(A 3)的基准。 3个座椅包含有2,683个视频片段和15,004个问答对子,它们超越了粗糙的侵略性识别,评价攻击性场景中的角色意识推理. 基准并非只询问侵略是否发生,而是探索侵略行动和参与者-作用协会的模式,包括侵略者、受害者和旁观者。 这些问题需要模型来区分个人,解释相互作用,并正确约束参与者的行动. 通过注重精细的角色-动作推理,A 3 Central为评估当前MLLM能否可靠地理解攻击性的场景提供了一个挑战性的测试台.

blocks.en: Our experiments show that recent MLLMs struggle on this benchmark, with performance remaining below 50%. Accuracy consistently drops as questions require more compositional reasoning, from identifying a single attribute to jointly reasoning about actions and participant roles (Figure 1 , right). Error analysis further reveals a strong bias toward visually salient individuals, with models frequently misclassifying victims or bystanders as aggressors. These findings suggest that current MLLMs fail to reliably capture the interaction structure underlying aggressive scenes. Finally, we explore a simple role-graph prompting strategy that encourages structured reasoning over participant interactions, leading to improved performance on compositional reasoning tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验表明,最近 MLLMs 在这个基准上挣扎, 业绩保持在50%以下。 准确性不断下降,因为问题需要更多的组成推理,从确定单一属性到共同推理关于行动和参与者角色(图1,右侧). 错误分析进一步揭示了对视觉突出的个人的强烈偏见,模式往往将受害者或旁观者错误地归类为侵犯者。 这些调查结果表明,目前的MLLMs无法可靠地捕捉攻击性场景背后的相互作用结构. 最后,我们探索一个简单的角色图激励战略,鼓励结构化推理而不是参与者互动,从而改进组成推理任务的业绩。

blocks.en: We make the following contributions: 1) We introduce A 3 Bench, a benchmark for evaluating aggressive action and association in videos designed to assess fine-grained role-aware reasoning beyond coarse violence recognition, 2) We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of recent multimodal large language models in a zero-shot setting, showing that current systems struggle to reliably associate aggressive actions with the correct participants, with performance degrading significantly as reasoning complexity increases, and 3) Through detailed analysis, we identify systematic failures in role-action association, and show that a simple role-graph prompting strategy can improve structured reasoning in aggressive-scene understanding.
blocks.zh: 我们作出以下贡献: 1) 我们引入了三席制,作为评估侵略行动和关联的视频基准,旨在评估超出粗糙暴力识别范围的精细角色意识推理,2) 我们以零镜头设定对近期多式大型语言模型进行全面评估,显示当前系统难以将侵略行动与正确的参与者可靠地联系起来,而随着推理复杂性的提高,性能显著下降;3) 通过详细的分析,我们发现角色行动协会中系统性的失败,并表明简单的角色图提示策略可以改善在攻击-场景理解中的结构化推理.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Action recognition: The advancement of action recognition can be noted across video Tong et al. (2022) ; Wang et al. (2025a) , skeleton Wu et al. (2025) ; Zhu et al. (2025a) ; Wang et al. (2026) , and multimodal modalities Rasheed et al. (2023) ; Wang et al. (2025b) ; Ni et al. (2022) ; Huang et al. (2024) ; Ahmad et al. (2025) ; Cheng et al. (2024) . Certain methods, such as temporal localization Shi et al. (2023) ; Liu et al. (2024a) ; Liu and Liu (2025) allow more precise event boundary detection. Fine-grained recognition has advanced through unified keypoint-based frameworks Hachiuma et al. (2023) and atomic action decomposition Peng et al. (2024) . Action detection methods further localize and identify what each person is doing in space and time, but they typically focus on individual actions rather than the relationships between interacting participants. These methods still treat actions as a classification problem over participant-agnostic categories, without modeling the relationships between those involved.

Wang等人(2026年),以及多模式Rasheed等人(2023年);Wang等人(2025b年); Ni等 (2022年); 黄等 (2024年); Ahmad等 (2025年); Cheng等 (2024年). 某些方法,例如:时间本地化史等 (2023年);刘等 (2024a年);刘等 (2025年),可以更精确地探测出事件边界. 通过统一的关键点框架Hachiuma等人(2023年)和原子作用分解Peng等人(2024年),精细的识别得到了推进. 动作检测方法进一步将每个人在空间和时间上正在做的事情本地化并明确,但它们通常侧重于单个动作,而不是互动参与者之间的关系. 这些方法仍然将行动视为一个相对于参与者不可知类别而言的分类问题,而没有模拟参与者之间的关系。

blocks.en: Crime and anomaly detection: Anomaly detection and behavior analysis in security videos have been widely studied for identifying abnormal, unsafe, or criminal activities Zhao et al. (2023a) ; Liu et al. (2025) . In parallel, dedicated violence and aggression datasets have advanced the evaluation of models across diverse harmful scenarios, including fight detection, crowd violence, real-world security violence, intruder activity, child aggression, and crime/anomaly recognition Nievas et al. (2011) ; Kollias et al. (2025) ; Soliman et al. (2019) ; Hassner et al. (2012) ; Cheng et al. (2021) ; Mahi et al. (2024) ; Ali et al. (2025b) ; Wu et al. (2020) ; Ali et al. (2025c) ; An et al. (2025) ; Sultani et al. (2018) . Beyond visual understanding, text-based aggression detection has also examined aggressive behavior in language, such as harmful or hostile social-media comments Akter et al. (2022) , showing that aggression analysis spans multiple modalities. Most existing video benchmarks focus on violence, aggression, or anomaly detection with coarse event-level labels. In contrast, A 3 Bench evaluates fine-grained aggressive action association by requiring models to identify the actor, target, and role of each visible participant, exposing failures that prior benchmarks do not measure.
blocks.zh: 犯罪和异常检测: 安全视频中的异常检测和行为分析被广泛研究,以识别异常,不安全,或犯罪活动赵等 (2023a).;刘等 (2025). 与此同时,专门的暴力和侵略数据集推动了对各种有害情景模型的评估,包括战斗探测、人群暴力、现实世界安全暴力、入侵活动、儿童侵略和犯罪/异常识别Nievas等人(2011年);Kollias等人(2025年);Soliman等人(2019年);Hassner等人(2012年);Cheng等人(2021年);Mahi等人(2024年);Ali等人(2025年b; Wu等人(2020年);Ali等人(2025c); An等 (2025); Sultani等 (2018). 除了视觉理解之外,基于文字的侵略探测也研究了语言上的侵略行为,如有害或敌对的社会媒体评论. Akter等人(2022年),表明侵略分析跨越了多种模式. 大多数现有的视频基准侧重于暴力、侵犯或带有粗糙事件级标签的异常检测。 相反地,一个3个法官组通过要求模型确定每个明显参与者的行为者、目标和作用,从而评估精心设计的侵略性行动关联,揭露先前基准无法衡量的失败。

blocks.en: Compositional video reasoning: Existing benchmarks have explored compositional video understanding through temporal and causal reasoning Yi* et al. (2020) , spatio-temporal question answering Grunde-McLaughlin et al. (2021) , and situated reasoning over human interactions Wu et al. (2021) . More recent work evaluates fine-grained associations between agents, actions, and events using video-language entailment and challenging negative captions Saravanan et al. (2025) . While these assess general compositional reasoning, A 3 Bench focuses on aggressive interactions, requiring models to distinguish aggressors, victims, and bystanders and correctly associate actions with participant roles and interaction direction.

blocks.en: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs): Recent multimodal models have significantly expanded the scope of visual understanding by linking visual evidence with language-based semantic reasoning Radford et al. (2021) . Building on large-scale cross-modal pretraining, such models have enabled zero-shot and open-vocabulary recognition of human actions and activities Ali et al. (2025a) ; Wang et al. (2025b) ; Ni et al. (2022) ; Rasheed et al. (2023) ; Huang et al. (2024) ; Ahmad et al. (2025) ; Wang et al. (2024) . Recent video-centric MLLMs Bai et al. (2025a) ; Zhu et al. (2025b) ; Lu et al. (2025) ; Google DeepMind (2026) , further extend these capabilities to temporal and multi-frame reasoning over complex events Maaz et al. (2024) ; Yu et al. (2023) ; Zhao et al. (2023b) . These advances motivate the use of MLLMs for aggressive action and association, where models must not only identify the observed action but also reason about the relationships between people and their roles.

blocks.en: 3 Aggressive Action and Association Benchmark (A 3 Bench)
blocks.zh: 3 侵略行动和联系基准(A 3席)

blocks.en: A 3 Bench is designed to evaluate fine-grained aggressive action and association in real-world videos. The benchmark construction begins with video curation and structured annotation of aggressive interactions, including actions, participants, roles, and scene context. These annotations are then converted into three levels of diagnostic VQA questions, ranging from basic attribute recognition to compound association and detailed aggressor-action-victim reasoning. The resulting benchmark enables controlled evaluation of MLLMs under a unified multiple-choice protocol.
blocks.zh: A级 3 法官座堂旨在评价真实世界视频中精心策划的侵略行动和关联。 基准构建从视频解析和结构化地说明侵略性互动开始,包括行动、参与者、角色和场景背景。 随后这些说明被转换为诊断性VQA问题的三级,从基本属性识别到复合关联和详细的侵犯者-行动-受害者推理. 由此产生的基准使得能够根据统一的多选择协议对MLLMs进行有控制的评价.

blocks.en: 3.1 Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 建筑业

blocks.en: Video curation and annotation: We curate a benchmark of 2,683 video clips collected from diverse sources, including publicly available social-media videos, UCF-Crime Sultani et al. (2018) , and RWF-2000 Cheng et al. (2021) . Source videos are trimmed into shorter clips centered on individual interactions, resulting in an average clip duration of 5.75 seconds (standard deviation of 1.69 seconds), with most clips approximately 4 to 8 seconds long. The videos span a wide range of recording conditions, camera viewpoints, resolutions, scene layouts, and levels of visual clutter, reflecting the heterogeneity of real-world scenarios. The final corpus contains 2,234 clips with aggressive behavior and 449 non-aggressive clips.
blocks.zh: 视频解说和注释: 我们整理了从各种来源收集的2 683个视频剪辑的基准,包括公开提供的社会媒体视频、UCF-Crime Sultani等人(2018年)和RWF-2000。 程等 (2021) (中文(简体) ). 源视频被修剪成以个人互动为中心的更短的片段,导致平均片段持续5.75秒(标准偏差为1.69秒),大多数片段长约4至8秒. 视频跨越了广泛的录音条件,相机视角,分辨率,场景布局以及视觉杂乱程度,反映了现实世界情景的异同. 最终的官能团包含有2,234个带有攻击行为的片段和449个非攻击性的片段.

blocks.en: A group of annotators labeled each video with structured scene information. The annotations include: (1) the aggressive action being performed, selected from 17 aggressive action categories and a control “none” category for non-aggressive clips; a short appearance description of the (2) aggressor; (3) victim; (4) bystanders and (5) the environment or setting. As seen in Figure 2 , person descriptions are primarily based on clothing and coarse visual appearance, such as “person in a dark jacket,” while avoiding names, faces, demographic attributes, or other identifying information. This design reduces the risk of relying on sensitive attributes and focuses the benchmark on visual role and action understanding. If a certain role does not exist in the video clip, or the appearance is too ambiguous, that is left out in the annotations.
blocks.zh: 一组注释员给每段视频贴上结构化场景信息标签. 说明包括:(1) 从17个侵略行动类别和用于非侵略性剪辑的控制“无”类别中选出的侵略行动;(2) 侵略者的外观简介;(3) 受害者;(4) 旁观者和(5) 环境或环境。 如图2所显示的,人物描述主要基于衣着和粗糙的视觉外观,如"穿深色夹克的人",同时避免姓名,相貌,人口属性或其他识别信息. 这种设计降低了依赖敏感属性的风险,并将基准重点放在视觉角色和行动理解上. 如果视频剪辑中不存在某个角色,或者外表过于模糊,则在说明中被忽略.

blocks.en: Dataset distribution. A 3 Bench intentionally contains more aggressive than non-aggressive clips, as its primary objective is to evaluate fine-grained action and participant-role reasoning within aggressive interactions. Non-aggressive clips are included to evaluate whether models can recognize the absence of aggression. As shown in Figure 3 , A 3 Bench also exhibits a male-skewed participant distribution, reflecting the composition of the collected real-world source videos. This observation is consistent with broader crime statistics reporting higher male representation in several offense categories. According to the FBI’s 2019 arrest statistics, males accounted for 72.5% of all arrests, including 84.2% of robbery arrests, and 76.5% of aggravated-assault arrests Federal Bureau of Investigation (2020) . UNODC Global Study on Homicide 2023 also reports that approximately 91% of suspects brought to police for intentional homicide (across 50 countries) between 2018 and 2021 were male United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime (2023) .
blocks.zh: 数据集分布. 3名法官有意包含比非侵略性短片更具攻击性的内容,因为其首要目标是评价在侵略性互动中精细的行动和参与者作用推理. 包括了非攻击性的剪辑,以评估模型是否能够识别没有侵略. 如图3所显示的,一个3个法官组还展示了由男性操纵的参与者分布,反映了所收集的真实世界源视频的构成。 这一看法与更广泛的犯罪统计数据相一致,后者报告说,在若干犯罪类别中,男性所占比例较高。 根据联邦调查局2019年的逮捕统计,男性占了所有逮捕的72.5%,包括抢劫逮捕的84.2%,以及恶毒逮捕的76.5%的联邦调查局(2020年). 毒品和犯罪问题办公室关于2023年凶杀案的全球研究报告还报告说,2018年至2021年期间(50个国家)因故意杀人被带入警方的嫌疑人中约有91%是联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室的男性(2023年)。

blocks.en: Annotation quality assurance: We employ a structured, consensus-driven annotation protocol involving four annotators to ensure visually grounded and reliable annotations of aggressive interactions. Each annotator independently reviews assigned videos and labels the aggressive-action category, appearance descriptions of aggressors, victims, and bystanders, and scene environment. Participants are identified using clothing and other coarse, non-identifying visual cues (e.g., “person in a red shirt”), while avoiding race, gender, age, and other sensitive attributes. Demographic statistics in Figure 3 are reported only at the aggregate corpus level and are not used in questions, answer options, or role labels.
blocks.zh: 注释质量保证: 我们采用有条理的、由共识驱动的、有四个注解员参与的注解程序,以确保有目共睹和可靠地说明积极的相互作用。 每个注释员独立地审查指定的视频,并标出侵略行动类别、侵犯者、受害者和旁观者的外表描述以及现场环境。 确定参与者时使用服装和其他粗糙、不识别的视觉提示(例如“穿红衬衫的人”),同时避免种族、性别、年龄和其他敏感属性。 图3中的人口统计数据仅以汇总形式报告,不用于提问、回答选项或角色标签。

blocks.en: Annotators flag videos with ambiguous actions, interaction direction, participant visibility, or appearance descriptions, particularly in crowded, occluded, blurry, black-and-white, or low-resolution scenes. Flagged annotations are withheld from finalization pending group review. After each annotation batch, another team member independently re-reviews a randomly selected subset. Aggressor-victim direction conflicts occur in fewer than 5% of cross-checked cases, while appearance-description disagreements occur in approximately 20%, primarily because annotators select different clothing or coarse visual cues to describe the same participant rather than identifying different participants. All flagged cases and disagreements identified during cross-checking are collectively reviewed. Role-direction disagreements are resolved by determining who initiated and who received the aggressive action, while appearance-description disagreements are resolved by selecting the clearest non-identifying description. When reliable consensus cannot be reached, the corresponding attribute is omitted rather than guessed. Periodic spot checks and targeted re-review of difficult cases continue throughout benchmark development, refining participant descriptions and removing ambiguous attributes while retaining only visually supported annotations.
blocks.zh: 注释者将带有模棱两可动作,互动方向,参与者能见度,或外观描述的视频标出,特别是在拥挤,被占据,模糊,黑白,或低分辨率的场景中. 在小组审查之前,不最后确定标有标记的说明。 每次批注后,另一名队员独立地对随机选择的子集进行再审. 侵犯者-受害者方向冲突发生在不到5%的交叉检查案件中,而外观描述分歧则发生在大约20%,这主要是因为注释者选择不同的服装或粗糙的视觉提示来描述同一个参与者,而不是确定不同的参与者. 所有标出的案件和在交叉核对中发现的分歧都经过集体审查。 角色指导上的分歧通过确定谁发起和谁接受侵略行动来解决,而外观描述上的分歧则通过选择最明确的非识别描述来解决. 当无法达成可靠的共识时,相应的属性会被省略而不是被猜测出. 在整个基准制定过程中,继续定期抽查和有针对性地对困难案例进行再审查,完善参与者说明并去除模棱两可的属性,同时只保留视觉支持的说明。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Example videos from A 3 Bench. Each video is annotated with structured role and scene information, including the aggressor, victim, bystanders, aggressive action, and environment. Person descriptions are based primarily on clothing and coarse visual attributes rather than identity, enabling fine-grained actor-role association while avoiding personally identifying information.
blocks.zh: 图2:一个3个法官的视频示例。 每段录像都附有结构化的角色和场景信息,包括侵略者、受害者、旁观者、侵略行动和环境。 人物描述主要基于衣着和粗糙的视觉属性,而不是身份,使得有精细纹饰的演员-角色相通,同时避免个人识别信息.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Demography (aggressors/victims) and environment settings. A 3 Bench contains a larger proportion of male and adult participants (aggressors or victims) among videos where demographic attributes are identifiable. For scene conditions, many clips are ambiguous in time of day, but among identifiable cases, slightly more aggressive clips occur during daytime than night, and most are captured in indoor environments.
blocks.zh: 图3:人口统计(侵犯者/受害者)和环境环境。 3名法官中有较大比例的男性和成人参与者(侵犯者或受害者)在可识别的人口特征的视频中。 对于场景条件来说,许多剪辑在白天是模棱两可的,但是在可识别的病例中,在白天比夜晚稍多地发生有攻击性的剪辑,大多数是在室内环境中被捕获.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Distribution of annotated roles per video. The role-count distribution is also skewed towards most clips containing a single identifiable aggressor and victim, while bystanders are more variable and often appear in larger groups.
blocks.zh: 图4:每个视频的注解角色分布情况。 角色计数分配也向包含一个单一可识别的侵略者和被害者的大多数片段倾斜,而旁观者则多变多变并经常出现在较大的群体中.

blocks.en: Question generation and distractor design: From the annotation corpus, we generate multiple-choice video question-answer pairs that function as controlled diagnostic probes for aggressive interaction understanding. Rather than only evaluating whether a model can recognize an action label, A 3 Bench is designed to expose distinct failure modes in video-language models, including weak role grounding, poor action-participant binding, confusion between visible and relevant people, failure to model interaction directionality, and reliance on answer-choice priors. The questions are organized into three tiers of increasing complexity: basic questions , compound questions , and detailed questions . Figure 1 illustrates representative examples from these three categories, and Figure 5 reports their subcategories and overall distribution across the benchmark.
blocks.zh: 问题生成和分心器设计: 从注解体中,我们产生多选择视频问答对子,发挥控制性诊断探针的作用,以进行积极的交互理解. A 3 Central不仅评价一个模型是否能够识别一个动作标签,还旨在揭露视频语言模型中不同的故障模式,包括角色定位薄弱,动作-参与者绑定不良,可见和相关的人之间混淆,无法模拟交互方向性,以及依赖答案-选择前传等. 这些问题分为三个层次,日益复杂:基本问题、复合问题和详细问题。 图1显示了这三类的代表性例子,图5报告了其亚类和整个基准的总体分布情况。

blocks.en: Basic questions test whether a model can recover a single atomic attribute of the scene. These include primary action identification, where the model must recognize the aggressive action taking place; aggressor or victim identification, where the model must identify who performs the aggression or who is targeted; and role identification, where the model is given a person description and must assign the correct role, such as aggressor, victim, or bystander. These questions diagnose whether the model can localize individual actions and participant roles before requiring relational reasoning.
blocks.zh: 基本问题测试一个模型是否能够恢复场景的单一原子属性. 其中包括主要行动识别,即模型必须承认正在发生的侵略行动;攻击者或受害者识别,即模型必须确定实施侵略者或目标;角色识别,即模型得到个人描述并必须指定正确的角色,如侵略者、受害者或旁观者。 这些问题判断该模型是否能够在要求关系推理之前将个人行动和参与者角色本地化.

blocks.en: Compound questions test whether a model can bind two scene attributes correctly. These include aggressor-victim, action-aggressor, and action-victim associations. Since each answer choice is only correct when all components are jointly correct, these questions diagnose whether models merely recognize visible actions or participants independently, or whether they can associate the correct action with the correct person and role.
blocks.zh: 复合测试一个模型是否能够正确绑定两个场景属性. 这些组织包括侵犯者受害者、行动侵犯者和行动受害者协会。 由于每个答案选择只有在所有组件都共同正确时才是正确的,这些问题判断模型是只识别出可见的动作还是独立参与者,还是能够将正确的动作与正确的人和角色联系起来.

blocks.en: Detailed questions test whether a model can recover the full event structure of an aggressive interaction. These include aggressor-action-victim questions, which ask who did what to whom, and sequence verification questions, which require selecting the correct structured description of the interaction. These questions specifically diagnose failures in directionality, role distinction, and holistic event understanding, since a model must distinguish the aggressor from the victim and construct a coherent representation of the interaction rather than predict a participant-agnostic action category.
blocks.zh: 详细的问题测试一个模型能否恢复一个侵略性互动的全部事件结构. 这些问题包括攻击者-行动-受害者问题(询问谁对谁做了什么)和确定核查问题的先后顺序,这需要选择对互动的正确结构化描述。 这些问题具体地诊断了方向性、作用区分和整体事件理解方面的失败,因为一个模式必须区分攻击者与受害者,并构建一种互动的连贯表述,而不是预测一个参与者不可知的行动类别。

blocks.en: Importantly, Basic, Compound, and Detailed questions are generated from the same underlying video pool, with each video contributing approximately seven questions across multiple complexity levels.
blocks.zh: 重要的是,基本问题、复合问题和详细问题都来自同一个基本视频库,每个视频提供大约七个问题,涉及多个复杂层面。

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Distribution of question types in A 3 Bench. The benchmark contains three levels of questions with increasing association complexity: Basic questions focus on single attributes; Compound questions require associating two scene components; and Detailed questions require full interaction understanding.
blocks.zh: 图5:问题类型在A 3 座席中的分布。 基准包含三个层次的问题,其关联的复杂性越来越大: 基本问题侧重于单一属性; 复合问题需要将两个场景部分联系起来; 详细问题需要充分的互动理解.

blocks.en: We design distractor choices as targeted diagnostic stress tests: they are visually plausible, semantically close to the correct answer, and tied to specific failure modes. Cross-video distractors are sampled from real annotations of other clips, so incorrect options still contain natural actions, roles, and participant descriptions rather than synthetic or obviously invalid answers. Same-video distractors use visible non-target participants from the queried clip, such as the victim or a bystander when asking for the aggressor, preventing models from relying only on visibility, saliency, or person presence. Role reversals and bystander substitutions preserve much of the event content while swapping aggressor and victim roles or assigning bystanders to active roles, directly testing interaction directionality and the distinction between active participation and mere presence. Negation questions include answers such as “no aggressive action is taking place” to test whether models verify visual evidence rather than assume aggression is present. Frequency-inverted distractors are constructed so that each key distractor property, such as an action, role, or participant description, appears across multiple answer options, making marginal answer frequency uninformative. This forces models to reason over the complete aggressor-action-victim structure rather than selecting the option with the most common or familiar textual components.
blocks.zh: 我们设计分心者选择作为有针对性的诊断应激测试:这些选择在视觉上是可信的,与正确的答案密不可分,并与具体的失败模式挂钩。 Cross-video分取器从其他片段的真实说明中取出样本,因此不正确的选项仍然包含自然动作,角色,以及参与者描述,而不是合成或明显无效的答案. 同声视频分辨器使用来自被询问片段的可见非目标参与者,如受害者或旁观者在请求攻击者时,阻止模型只依靠能见度,能见度或人物存在. 角色倒置和旁观者取而代之的做法保留了事件的大部分内容,同时将攻击者和被害者的角色互换,或将旁观者指定为主动角色,直接测试互动的方向性以及积极参与和仅仅是存在之间的区别. 否认问题包括“没有采取侵略行动”等答案,以检验模型是否核实视觉证据而不是假设存在侵略。 频率倒置分流器的构造使得每个关键分流器属性,如动作,角色,或参与者描述,都出现在多个答题选项中,使得边际接题频率不具有信息化性. 这迫使模型对完全的侵略者-行动-受害者结构进行理性分析,而不是选择最常见或最熟悉的文字部分。

blocks.en: 3.2 Benchmarked Models
blocks.zh: 3.2 基准模式

blocks.en: We evaluate 17 representative model configurations on A 3 Bench to assess their ability to perform aggressive action and association. All of our chosen models are trained on very large datasets with high-level video understanding.
blocks.zh: 我们评价了3个席位的17个代表性模式组合,以评估其采取积极行动和结社的能力。 我们所有选取的模型都接受了关于非常大的数据集的训练,具有高水平的视频理解.

blocks.en: General-Purpose Models. The evaluated models include two CLIP-based video-language models, ViCLIP Wang et al. (2024) and X-CLIP Ni et al. (2022) , alongside several recent open-weight MLLM families, including Gemma Google DeepMind (2026) , InternVideo Wang et al. (2025d) , InternVL Chen et al. (2024) ; Zhu et al. (2025b) ; Wang et al. (2025c) , LLaVA-Video Zhang et al. (2025b) , Ovis Lu et al. (2025) , Qwen-VL Bai et al. (2025b) ; Bai et al. (2025a) , and VideoLLaMA Zhang et al. (2025a) . Among closed-source, we include GPT 5.1 OpenAI (2025) . These families differ in visual encoder design, video modeling strategy, instruction tuning, model scale, and reasoning behavior.
blocks.zh: 通用型号. 评估模型包括两个基于CLIP的视频语言模型:VICLIP Wang等 (2024)和X-CLIP Ni等. 包括Gemma Google DeepMind(2026)、InternVideo Wang等(2025d)、InternVL。 陈等 (2024年); 朱等 (2025年b). 王等 (2025c), LLaVA-Video 张等 (2025b),. Ovis Lu等人(2025年), Quen-VL Bai等人(2025b); Bai等人(2025a)和VideoLLAMA 张等 (2025a). 在封闭源代码中,我们包括了GPT 5.1 OpenAI (2025). 这些家族在视觉编码器设计,视频建模策略,指令调和,模型尺度,推理行为上各不相同.

blocks.en: Reasoning and Prompted Variants. To investigate whether explicit reasoning improves aggressive action and association, we additionally evaluate reasoning-oriented variant of Qwen3-VL-8B Bai et al. (2025a) . We also evaluate InternVL3.5-8B Wang et al. (2025c) under two reasoning-style prompting settings: a detailed chain-of-thought (CoT) prompt and a Dream-of-Thoughts (inspired from Grover et al. (2024) ) prompt. These variants encourage intermediate reasoning before producing a final answer, allowing us to test whether step-by-step inference helps models distinguish aggressors, victims, bystanders, actions, and scene context.
blocks.zh: 合理和迅速的备选案文。 为了调查明确推理是否改进了侵略行动和关联,我们进一步评价了Qune3-VL-8B Bai等人(2025a)的以推理为导向的变体。 我们还评估实习生VL3.5-8B Wang等 (2025c)在两种推理风格的提示设置下:一是详细的思维链(CoT)提示和一想梦(由Grover等 (2024)启发)提示. 这些变体鼓励在产生最终答案之前进行中间推理,使我们能够测试分步推论是否有助于模型区分攻击者,受害者,旁观者,行动,以及场景背景.

blocks.en: 3.3 Implementation Details, Evaluation Protocol, and Metrics
blocks.zh: 3.3 实施细节、评价协议和计量

blocks.en:
All experiments are zero-shot. Open-source models are evaluated using their official implementations, hyperparameters, and released weights on a single NVIDIA RTX A6000 (48 GB) or A100 (80 GB) GPU. Qwen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct Bai et al. (2025b) was run on the quantized version to fit in memory. We use a multiple-choice video question answering (VQA) protocol across all models: for each video-question pair, the model is prompted to select the most appropriate answer from the provided options. Depending on the question type and the size of the valid answer space, each question contains four to eight answer choices, including one correct answer and a set of diagnostic distractors. The position of the correct answer is uniformly shuffled across all questions to mitigate positional bias.
We report accuracy as the primary evaluation metric.
blocks.zh:
所有实验都是零发. 开源模型使用其正式实施,超参数来评价,并在单NVIDIA RTX A6000(48GB)或A100(80GB)GPU上发布权重. Quen2.5-VL-72B-Instruct Bai等 (2025b)在被分解的版本上运行以适应内存. 我们在所有模型中都使用多选择视频问答(VQA)协议:对于每对视频问答,该模型被激励从所提供的选项中选择最合适的答案. 根据问题类型和有效答案空间的大小,每个问题包含4到8个答案选择,包括一个正确的答案和一组诊断分辨器. 正确答案的立场在所有问题上均被统一打乱,以缓解立场上的偏差.
我们把准确性作为主要评价尺度。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Results and Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 实验结果和分析

blocks.en: Table 2 summarizes model performance on A 3 Bench. We report both overall accuracy, computed as the question-count-weighted average, and category average, computed as the unweighted mean across Basic, Compound, and Detailed questions. Overall, current MLLMs perform poorly on the benchmark: most models achieve below 50% accuracy, and even the best-performing model reaches only 46.96% overall accuracy and 44.30% category average. These results indicate that aggressive action and association remains challenging for state-of-the-art systems. In particular, current MLLMs struggle when evaluation moves beyond coarse aggression recognition and requires identifying who is involved, what action occurs, and how participants are related.
blocks.zh: 表2总结了3名法官的示范业绩。 我们既报告总的准确性,以问题加权平均数计算,又报告类别平均数,以基本、复合和详细问题的未加权平均数计算。 总体而言,目前的MLLMs在基准上表现不佳:大多数模型的准确度低于50%,甚至最佳的模型也只达到46.96%的总体准确度和44.30%的类别平均值. 这些结果表明,对最先进的系统来说,侵略行动和联合仍然是挑战。 特别是,当评价超越粗糙的侵略性承认时,目前的MLLMs会挣扎,需要确定谁参与,发生什么行动,参与者如何联系。

blocks.en: Table 2: Benchmarking models on A 3 Bench. Reported metric is accuracy (%) for Basic Questions, Compound Questions, Detailed Questions, Overall, and Average. Best and second-best performance are highlighted.
blocks.zh: 表2:三个法官的基准模型。 报告的指标是基本问题、复合问题、详细问题、总体和平均数的准确性(%)。 突出表现最佳和次佳。

blocks.en: Human evaluation. We additionally conduct a human evaluation involving 34 participants using the same video-question pairs and answer choices presented to the models. Each participant answers five questions from five distinct action classes, with one video sampled per class. In total, we collect 170 responses, comprising 85 Basic, 49 Compound, and 36 Detailed questions. Human participants achieve an overall accuracy of 83.5%, highlighting substantial room for improvement of model performance in compositional understanding of aggressive interactions.
blocks.zh: 人性评价. 此外,我们还利用同样的视频问题对34名参与者进行了人文评估,并回答了向模型提出的选择。 每个参与者回答5个不同动作类的5个问题,每个类有1个视频样本. 我们总共收集了170个答复,包括85个基本问题、49个复合问题和36个详细问题。 人类参与者的总体精度达到83.5%,突出表明模型性能在对攻击性相互作用的构成理解方面有很大的改进余地.

blocks.en: 4.1 Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.1 分析

blocks.en: Performance degrades as aggression understanding becomes more compositional. Models achieve an average accuracy of 44.11% on Basic questions, but performance drops to 35.51% on Compound questions and further to 27.29% on Detailed questions. This monotonic decline shows that current MLLMs do not simply fail at rare aggression labels; they fail progressively as the task requires role-action binding. Models can sometimes identify isolated visual cues, such as an action category, a salient participant, or a single role, but struggle once these cues must be composed into a structured interaction. Compound questions expose failures in binding two attributes, such as linking the correct action to the correct aggressor or victim. Detailed questions further require the full aggressor-action-victim structure, or who did what to whom. The sharp drop on these questions indicates failures in directionality, role assignment, and person-action binding.
blocks.zh: 性能随着侵略性理解的形成而退化。 模型在基本问题上的平均精度为44.11%,但在复合问题上,性能下降至35.51%,在详细问题上则进一步下降至27.29%. 这种单调的下降表明,目前的MLLM并非在稀有的侵略标签上简单地失败;它们会逐渐失败,因为任务需要角色动作约束. 模型有时可以识别出孤立的视觉提示,如动作类,突出的参与者,或单一的角色等,但一旦这些提示必须被结构化的交互所构成,就进行斗争. 复杂的问题暴露出两个属性的约束失败,例如将正确的行动与正确的侵略者或受害者联系起来. 详细的问题还需要有完整的侵略者-行动-受害者结构,或由谁对谁采取行动。 这些问题的尖锐下降表明方向性、角色分配和人员行动约束方面的失败。

blocks.en: Model-level trends show that the compositional drop is not uniform across systems. VideoLLaMA3-7B exhibits the steepest collapse, suggesting strong reliance on single-attribute cues. Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct shows a small Basic-to-Compound drop but a much larger Compound-to-Detailed drop, indicating that pairwise association does not transfer to full aggressor-action-victim reasoning. Ovis2.5-9B shows the reverse pattern, with larger early drops and smaller later drops, suggesting that role-action binding is their main bottleneck. Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct achieves the strongest Compound performance but still degrades on Detailed questions, while ViCLIP and LLaVA-Video-7B-Qwen2 remain weak across all tiers. The InternVL3.5-8B DoT Wang et al. (2025c) ; Grover et al. (2024) variant and X-CLIP are notable exceptions, with Detailed accuracy slightly exceeding Compound accuracy.
blocks.zh: 模型一级的趋势表明,各系统的组成下降并不一致。 VideoLLAMA3-7B显示最陡峭的倒塌,表明强烈依赖单属性提示. Quen2.5-VL-7B-指令显示Basic-to-Compound下降,但更大规模的化合物-细节下降,表明对等关联不会转移到完全的侵略者-行动-受害者推理. Ovis2.5-9B显示反向模式,早期下降较大而后下降较小,暗示角色-动作绑定是他们的主要瓶颈. Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct实现最强的复合性能,但在详细问题上仍会降解;而VICLIP和LLaVA-Video-7B-Qune2则在各个级别上仍然很弱. 实习生VL3.5-8B 点数 Wang等 (2025c); Grover等 (2024)变体和X-CLIP是显著的例外,详细精度略高于化合物精度.

blocks.en: Reasoning helps, but not uniformly. Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking underperforms its instruction-tuned counterpart across all categories, dropping from 46.96% to 39.37% overall, suggesting that generic thinking mode does not necessarily improve role-action association. In contrast, reasoning prompts improve InternVL3.5-8B: CoT and DoT increases overall accuracy. The gains are most pronounced on Detailed questions, where InternVL3.5-8B rises from 28.75% to 33.13% with CoT and 40.90% with DoT. This suggests that structured reasoning is more useful when the task requires full aggressor-action-victim binding.
blocks.zh: 理性有帮助,但并不一致。 Qune3-VL-8B-Thinking表现不佳,其指令调试的对应器在所有类别中,总体从46.96%下降到39.37%,这表明通用思维模式并不一定能改善角色-行动关联. 相形之下,推理提示改进了InternVL3.5-8B:COT和DOT提高了整体准确性. 这些收益在详细问题上最为突出,实习生VL3.5-8B的成绩从28.75%上升到33.13%,而COT则上升到40.90%。 这表明,当任务要求侵略者 -- -- 行动受害者 -- -- 具有充分约束力时,结构化推理更有用。

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Error analysis of action and role association averaged across models. We analyze model failures on Basic questions by decomposing predictions across (left) action vs. role correctness , (center) aggressor vs. victim correctness , and (right) role identification . MLLMs struggle not only to recognize aggressive actions, but also to assign the correct roles to the persons involved.
blocks.zh: 图6:各模型对行动和角色关联的错误分析平均值。 我们通过解析跨(左)动作的预测与角色正确性,(中)侵略者与受害者正确性,以及(右)角色识别来分析基本问题的模型失败. MLLM公司不仅努力承认侵略行动,而且努力将正确的角色指派给有关人员。

blocks.en: Models often identify participants without recognizing the correct aggressive action. To understand whether errors arise from recognizing the aggressive behavior or identifying the relevant participants, we analyze videos that include both a Basic primary action question and at least one aggressor or victim identification question. Figure 6 (left) reports results averaged across models. Models identify the correct aggressor or victim while failing to recognize the correct action in 26% of cases, whereas they recognize the correct action while failing to identify the relevant role in only 17% of cases. Another 16% of cases are correct on both, while 41% are incorrect on both. This pattern indicates that models are more likely to localize socially salient participants than to distinguish the fine-grained aggressive action being performed. Thus, even when participant grounding partially succeeds, current MLLMs often still lack reliable aggression understanding.
blocks.zh: 模式往往在不承认正确的侵略行动的情况下确定参与者。 为了了解识别侵略行为或识别相关参与者是否出错,我们分析包括基本主要行动问题和至少一个识别侵略者或受害者问题的视频。 图6(左)报告各模型的平均结果。 模式确定正确的侵犯者或受害者,同时不承认26%案件中的正确行动,而模式确认正确的行动,同时没有确定只有17%案件中的相关作用。 另外16%的病例是正确的,而41%的病例是不正确的。 这种模式表明,模型更有可能使具有社会影响力的参与者本地化,而不是区分正在开展的精细侵略行动。 因此,即使参加者部分成功,目前的多边信贷额度仍然缺乏可靠的侵略理解。

blocks.en: Models are biased toward assigning the aggressor role. Figures 6 (center, right) show a consistent role-grounding failure: models tend to over-assign the aggressor role when identifying participants in aggressive interactions. In Figure 6 (center), for videos containing both Basic victim and aggressor identification questions, only 22% of cases correctly identify the aggressor and the victim simultaneously, while 31% fail on both roles. Among partial successes, models more often identify the aggressor while missing the victim (28%) than the other way (19%), suggesting that victim grounding is unreliable. Figure 6 (right) shows the same bias in role classification: many ground-truth victims (37%) and bystanders (32%) are predicted as aggressors. These errors suggest that models often treat visual involvement, proximity, or saliency as evidence of aggression, rather than reasoning about who initiates the action and who is targeted.
blocks.zh: 模式偏向于指定侵略者的角色。 图6(中,右)显示一贯的角色定位失败:模型往往在识别侵略互动参与者时过度指定侵略者角色. 在图6(中心)中,在包含基本受害者和侵犯者身份问题的视频中,只有22%的案件同时正确识别侵犯者和受害者,31%的案件未能同时识别。 在部分成功中,模型往往在缺少受害者(28%)的同时识别侵犯者,而不是以其他方式识别受害者(19%),这表明受害者的定位是不可靠的。 图6(正确)显示角色分类存在同样的偏差:许多地面真相受害者(37%)和旁观者(32%)被预测为侵犯者。 这些错误表明,模型往往将视觉参与、相近或显著性作为侵略的证据,而不是对谁发起行动和谁成为目标进行推理。

blocks.en: Distractor analysis reveals different failure modes across question complexity. Distractor analysis shows that models are especially vulnerable when incorrect options preserve visually plausible participants or partially match the interaction structure. For Basic questions, role-reversal distractors are consistently more challenging than cross-video distractors for most models, indicating that models often recognize relevant people but confuse their roles. For Compound questions, role-reversal and wrong-action distractors dominate, showing that models struggle to jointly bind the correct action with the correct aggressor or victim. In Detailed questions, frequency-inverted distractors dominate showing that models may rely on answer-choice priors rather than visual grounding, selecting options with familiar or frequently co-occurring action-role-person components instead of recovering the full aggressor-action-victim structure.
blocks.zh: 灾难分析揭示了不同故障模式的复杂问题。 灾难分析显示,当错误的选项保留了视似可能的参与者或部分符合交互结构时,模型特别脆弱. 对于基本问题来说,角色倒置分心器对于大多数模型来说,始终比跨视频分心器更具挑战性,这表明模型往往会识别相关的人而混淆他们的角色. 对于复杂的问题,角色倒转和错误行动的分心者占据了主导地位,表明模式努力将正确的行动与正确的侵略者或受害者联系在一起。 在详细的问题中,频率倒置的分心器占主导地位,显示模型可能依赖于答案选择前题,而不是视觉地面,选择了熟悉或经常共同发生的动作-作用-人物组件的选项,而不是完全恢复侵略者-动作-被害者的结构.

blocks.en: Model-level patterns reveal distinct vulnerabilities across question tiers. In Basic questions, Ovis2.5-9B is vulnerable to role-reversal distractors, while LLaVA-Video-7B spreads errors across cross-video, wrong-role, and bystander-substitution options, suggesting weaker visual grounding. InternVL3.5-8B-DoT, ViCLIP, and X-CLIP also show high bystander-substitution errors, suggesting over-attention to visible non-participants. In Compound questions, ViCLIP, X-CLIP, and LLaVA-Video-7B show more wrong-aggressor and wrong-victim errors than most models, indicating weaker participant grounding. In Detailed questions, frequency-inverted distractors dominate for most models, while GPT-5.1 shows more errors involving role reversals.
blocks.zh: 模式层面的格局显示出不同层次的问题的明显脆弱性。 在Basic questions中,Ovis2.5-9B容易被角色倒置分心器所伤害,而LLaVA-Video-7B则将错误分散到交叉视频,错误的作用,以及旁观者取而代之的选项中,暗示视觉地平面更弱. InternVL3.5-8B-DoT,VICLIP,和X-CLIP也显示高旁观者-替代错误,暗示了对可见的非参与者的过度关注. 在复合问题中,VICLIP,X-CLIP,和LLaVA-Video-7B比大多数模型显示出更多的错误侵犯者和错误受害者错误,表明参与者搁浅能力较弱. 在细节问题中,频率倒置分流器在大多数模型中占主导地位,而GPT-5.1则显示出更多涉及角色倒置的错误.

blocks.en: Models over-predict aggression even in non-aggressive clips. We conduct a free-form social appropriateness evaluation on four relatively strong models Lu et al. (2025) ; Chen et al. (2024) ; Zhu et al. (2025b) ; Bai et al. (2025a) . Each model is asked to characterize the social appropriateness of the action shown in a video. Models are generally able to identify aggressive or socially inappropriate behavior in aggressive clips, with most models reaching 78.2%-89.8% accuracy. However, on non-aggressive clips, they frequently still attribute inappropriate or aggressive behavior to the videos, with most models near or below 60% accuracy. This indicates that current models are sensitive to aggressive cues but also exhibit a strong aggression prior, over-predicting aggression even when no aggressive behavior is present. InternVL2.5-8B is more balanced across aggressive and non-aggressive clips, but both scores are close to 60%; given the 50% binary chance level, this suggests that it does not reliably solve either side of the task.
blocks.zh: 模式的过度预测侵略,即使是在非侵略性的片段. 我们对四个相对强大的模型Lu等(2025);Chen等(2024);Zhu等(2025b); Bai等 (2025a) (英语). 要求每个模型描述视频中显示的动作的社会适宜性. 模型一般能够在攻击性片段中识别出攻击性或社会上不恰当的行为,而大多数模型的准确度达到78.2%-89.8%. 然而,在非侵犯性的剪辑上,他们仍然经常将不适当或攻击性的行为归咎于视频,大多数模型的准确度接近或低于60%. 这表明,目前的模型对攻击性提示很敏感,但即使不存在攻击性行为,在侵略之前也表现出了强烈的侵略性。 InternVL2.5-8B在攻击性和非攻击性片段之间较为平衡,但两者的分数都接近于60%;鉴于50%的二进制机会水平,这表明它无法可靠地解决任何一面的任务.

blocks.en: Scene context adds another layer of grounding difficulty. We further evaluate whether models can associate aggressive actions with their surrounding scene context using a subset of videos with clearly identifiable environments. Models are asked to identify both the action and the environment in which it occurs. Adding this scene-grounding requirement makes the task harder for most models: 12 evaluated models show lower accuracy on action-environment association than on primary action recognition, with their average accuracy dropping from 38.56% to 32.34%. This indicates that models struggle not only to recognize aggressive actions, but also to ground them in the correct environmental context. Interestingly, InternVL3.5-8B and its reasoning variants are relatively robust, showing little degradation. Overall, however, the drop for most models suggests that reliable action-environment association requires joint reasoning over local behavior and broader scene context.
blocks.zh: 场景上下文又增加了一层地平面难度. 我们进一步评价模型是否可以使用具有明确可识别环境的分集视频,将侵略行动与其周围的场景背景联系起来。 要求模型既确定行动,又确定发生行动的环境。 加上这种场景定位要求使得大多数模型的任务更加困难:12个被评价的模型在动作与环境关联方面显示的精度低于初级动作识别,平均精度从38.56%下降到32.34%. 这表明模式不仅努力承认侵略行动,而且努力将其置于正确的环境背景之下。 有趣的是,InternVL3.5-8B及其推理变体相对稳健,表现出几乎没有降解. 然而,总体而言,大多数模型的下降表明,可靠的行动-环境关联需要针对当地行为和更广泛的场景背景进行联合推理.

blocks.en: Detailed results and analysis charts are provided in the Supplementary.
blocks.zh: 补充报告中提供了详细结果和分析图表。

blocks.en: 4.2 Role-graph prompting
blocks.zh: 4.2 角色图提示

blocks.en: We observe that models often over-assign the aggressor role, confusing victims or bystanders with active participants. To encourage more explicit role-action reasoning, we explore a role-graph prompting strategy as a diagnostic structured-reasoning intervention. As shown in Figure 7 , the graph represents aggressive-scene understanding through interaction direction, participant roles, and aggressive actions. We prepend this graph-based instruction template to each multiple-choice VQA query. The linguistic prompt serves as an interface that directs the model’s attention toward interaction direction and participant roles, without altering the underlying visual evidence or evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 我们注意到,模式往往过分指定侵略者的角色,使受害者或旁观者与积极参与者混淆。 为了鼓励更明确的角色行动推理,我们探索一种角色图激励战略,作为诊断性的结构化合理干预。 如图7所显示的,该图通过互动方向、参与者角色和侵略行动,代表了侵略-场面的理解。 我们把这个基于图表的指令模板放在每个多选择的VQA查询上. 语言提示作为一个界面,引导模型的注意力转向交互方向和参与者角色,而不改变基本的视觉证据或评价协议.

blocks.en: Table 3 compares baseline accuracy with role-graph prompting (RG) across six models. Role-graph prompting improves performance on five of the six models, with an average accuracy increase from 42.50% to 45.26%. Ovis2.5-9B shows the largest improvement, increasing from 43.16% to 50.28%. Smaller improvements are observed for InternVL2.5-8B and both Qwen2.5-VL models, while GPT-5.1 shows a slight decrease. These results suggest that explicitly encouraging models to consider participant roles and interaction direction can benefit aggressive-scene understanding, although the effectiveness varies across models. We view this as an exploratory approach to structured role-aware prompting rather than a comprehensive solution to compositional role-action reasoning. The detailed prompt and additional results are provided in the Supplementary.
blocks.zh: 表3将基线精确度与六个模型中的角色图提示(RG)进行比较。 角色图提示提高了6个型号中的5个型号的性能,平均精度从42.50%提高到45.26%. Ovis2.5-9B的改善幅度最大,从43.16%增至50.28%. InternVL2.5-8B和Quen2.5-VL两种模型的改进较小,而GPT-5.1显示略有下降. 这些结果表明,明确鼓励考虑参与者作用和互动方向的模型可以有利于积极的理解,尽管各模型的有效性各不相同。 我们认为,这是一种探索性办法,可以促使人们认识到结构性作用,而不是全面解决角色构成-行动推理。 补充报告中提供了迅速和额外的详细结果。

blocks.zh: 图7:角色图提示结构. 该图将侵略-场地理解分解为结构化的角色-行动推理,将互动,方向与参与者角色和侵略行动联系起来.

blocks.en: Table 3: Effect of role-graph prompting. Comparison of baseline overall accuracy with role-graph prompting (RG). Results suggest that explicit role-aware prompting can improve aggressive action and participant association, although gains vary across models.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We propose A 3 Bench, a benchmark for evaluating whether MLLMs can reason about aggressive actions and participant associations in videos. Unlike prior evaluations focused on aggression detection, A 3 Bench measures whether models can identify who initiates an action, who is affected, and how participants interact. Our evaluation across 17 models shows that current systems struggle with this task, with performance declining as questions require more compositional reasoning over actions and roles. We further observe an aggressor bias, where victims and bystanders are frequently misclassified as aggressors, suggesting that models fail to reliably capture interaction structure. Finally, we explore a role-graph prompting strategy that encourages structured reasoning over participant interactions and improves performance on most evaluated models. We hope A 3 Bench serves as a diagnostic benchmark for studying fine-grained role-aware video reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们提议设立一个三席小组,作为评估MLLMs是否能够在视频中说明攻击行动和参与者协会的理由的基准。 与以往侧重于发现侵略性的评价不同,一个3个法官组衡量模型是否能够确定谁发起行动、谁受到影响以及参与者如何互动。 我们对17个模式的评价表明,目前的系统正与这项任务相搏斗,由于问题需要更多关于行动和作用的构成推理,业绩下降。 我们进一步看到一种侵略者偏见,受害者和旁观者经常被错误地归类为侵略者,这表明模式无法可靠地抓住互动结构。 最后,我们探索一种角色图激励战略,鼓励对参与者互动进行结构化推理,并改进大多数评价模型的绩效。 我们希望,一个三组法官作为研究精细角色意识视频推理的诊断基准。

blocks.en: A.1 Limitations and Broader Impact
blocks.zh: A.1 限制和更广泛的影响

blocks.en: A 3 Bench focuses specifically on visible physical aggression in short video clips and does not cover broader forms of harmful behavior such as verbal abuse, long-term conflict, or subtle social interactions. Furthermore, A 3 Bench is designed to evaluate compositional reasoning over aggressive interactions rather than spatial or temporal action detection, and therefore does not provide participant bounding boxes or temporal tracks. Extending the benchmark with such annotations represents an important direction for future work. While A 3 Bench includes diverse videos, question types, and model families under a controlled evaluation protocol, cross-dataset generalization remains unexplored. Evaluating role-action reasoning across additional datasets and domains is an important direction for future research. This work aims to advance safer and more reliable video understanding systems for applications such as public safety, content moderation, and assistive monitoring. At the same time, aggressive-scene understanding systems may inherit societal biases or produce harmful misclassifications, particularly in high-stakes settings involving surveillance or security. We therefore position A 3 Bench as a diagnostic evaluation framework rather than a deployment-ready solution.
blocks.zh: A级 3 法官座椅在短视频片段中特别侧重于明显的人身攻击,不涵盖更广泛的有害行为形式,如辱骂,长期冲突,或微妙的社会互动. 此外,一个3个法官组旨在评价对侵略性相互作用的构成推理,而不是空间或时间行动探测,因此不提供参与者约束框或时间轨道。 以这种说明来延长基准是今后工作的一个重要方向。 虽然A 3 座椅包含多种视频,问题类型,以及受控评价协议下的模范家庭,但跨数据集通论仍未被探索. 评价其他数据集和领域的作用-行动推理是今后研究的一个重要方向。 这项工作旨在推进更安全和更可靠的视频理解系统,用于公共安全、内容节制和辅助监测等应用。 同时,攻击性场景理解系统可能继承社会偏见或造成有害的分类错误,特别是在涉及监视或安全的高幕环境下。 因此,我们把3个小组作为诊断性评价框架,而不是一个随时可以部署的解决办法。

blocks.en: A.2 Prompt and Multiple-choice question example

blocks.en: Effect of temporal sampling. To assess the importance of temporal information for aggressive action and association, we evaluate Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct using different numbers of uniformly sampled video frames. Table 4 reports performance using a single middle frame and 4, 8, and 16 frames, with 8 frames corresponding to our standard evaluation setting. Increasing temporal coverage from a single frame to 16 frames improves overall accuracy from 40.86% to 51.34%, with improvements across Basic, Compound, and Detailed questions. While performance is not strictly monotonic across all sampling configurations, these results suggest that temporal information is important for recognizing aggressive actions and associating them with the correct participants, beyond the static appearance and scene cues available from individual frames.
blocks.zh: 时间取样的效果。 为了评估时间信息对于积极行动和关联的重要性,我们利用不同数目的统一取样录像帧来评价Qune3-VL-8B-指示。 表4采用单一中间框架和4、8和16个框架报告业绩,8个框架与我们的标准评价设定相对应。 将时间范围从单一框架提高到16个框架,提高了总体准确度,从40.86%提高到51.34%,在基本、复合和详细问题上都有所改进。 虽然所有抽样组合的性能并非完全单一,但这些结果表明,时间信息对于识别攻击性行动并与正确的参与者联系起来十分重要,超出单个框架的静态外观和场景提示。

blocks.en: No-video baseline. To examine whether models can exploit language or answer-choice priors without visual evidence, we evaluate three MLLMs using only the question and answer options, without providing video frames. These results indicate that language and answer-choice priors alone are insufficient for reliable performance on A 3 Bench, further highlighting the importance of visual grounding.

blocks.en: Performance across participant sex. To examine potential demographic differences in participant grounding, we evaluate Basic aggressor identification, victim identification, and role identification questions separately according to the sex of the target participant. Averaged equally across all 17 model configurations, accuracy is nearly identical for male and female participants in aggressor identification (48.48% vs. 47.78%) and role identification (49.08% vs. 51.14%). However, female participants achieve substantially higher accuracy in victim identification (51.33% vs. 40.13%), a gap of 11.20%. This suggests that demographic performance differences are most pronounced in victim identification. Importantly, participant sex is used only for this diagnostic analysis and is not included in the benchmark’s role annotations, questions, or answer choices.
blocks.zh: 性参与者的表现。 为了审查参与者在定位方面可能存在的人口差异,我们根据目标参与者的性别,分别评估基本的侵犯者身份识别、受害者身份识别和角色识别问题。 在所有17个模型配置中,男女参与者在识别侵略者(48.48%对47.78%)和角色识别(49.08%对51.14%)中的准确度几乎相同。 然而,女性参与者在识别受害者方面获得的准确度要高得多(51.33%对40.13%),差距为11.20%。 这表明,在识别受害者方面,人口表现的差异最为明显。 重要的是,参与者的性别只用于这种诊断分析,而不包括在基准的作用说明、问题或答案选择中。

blocks.en: Aggressive scenes for fine-grained understanding. Table 6 compares model performance on questions associated with aggressive and non-aggressive clips. Most MLLMs achieve higher accuracy on non-aggressive clips, with pooled accuracy of 51.02% compared to 37.74% on aggressive clips. This suggests that models struggle more with fine-grained understanding of aggressive interactions, where identifying actions and correctly associating them with participant roles is challenging. Interestingly, this contrasts with the social appropriateness evaluation in Table 9 , where models generally perform better on aggressive clips. Together, these findings highlight a distinction between recognizing broad aggressive behavior and accurately reasoning about the actions and participant relationships within aggressive scenes.

blocks.en: A.5 Role-Graph Prompting

blocks.en: We translate the proposed role graph into a structured natural-language prompt for aggressive-scene understanding. The prompt defines each graph component, specifies the directed dependencies between components, and provides illustrative examples for aggressive scenes, bystander cases, and non-aggressive scenes. During evaluation, this role-graph prompt is prepended to each multiple-choice VQA query, and the model is instructed to output only the selected option number. The exact prompt used in our experiments is provided below.
blocks.zh: 我们把拟议的角色图转换成一种结构化的自然语言,促进积极的理解。 该快取定义了每个图的组件,指定了各组件之间的定向依存关系,并为攻击性的场景,旁观者案例,和不侵犯性的场景提供了示例. 在评价期间,这个角色图提示被准备到每个多选择的VQA查询,并且该模型被指示只输出所选选项号. 下面提供了我们实验中使用的准确提示。

blocks.en: Your primary task is to act as a causal reasoning engine for understanding aggressive scenes in videos. You will observe the persons present and use a causal graph to identify each person’s role and the nature of the aggressive interaction.
blocks.zh: 你的首要任务是发挥因果推理引擎的作用,以了解视频中攻击性的场景. 你们将观察在场人员,并使用一个因果图来识别每个人的角色和侵略性互动的性质。

blocks.en: ### Component Definitions
blocks.zh: * 构成部分定义

blocks.en: First, understand the meaning of each component (node) in our causal graph. These are the building blocks we use to analyze any aggressive scene.
blocks.zh: 首先,理解我们因果图中每个组件(节点)的含义. 这些是我们用来分析任何攻击性场景的构件。

blocks.en: • P (Persons): All individuals visible in the video. For example, ‘a man in a black coat’, ‘a woman in a red shirt’, ‘three people in the background’. Each person must be assigned exactly one role. • I (Interaction): Whether a given person is engaged in a direct physical interaction with another person. This is a binary branch point: – YES — the person is physically engaged with at least one other person, e.g., striking, grabbing, restraining, being struck. – NO — the person has no physical contact with any other person in the scene. • D (Direction): For persons where I = YES, the direction of the aggressive interaction: – INITIATING — the person is the one delivering the aggressive act, e.g., throwing a punch, grabbing, pushing. – RECEIVING — the person is the one on the receiving end of the aggressive act, e.g., being punched, being grabbed, being pushed. • R (Role): The role assigned to each person, inferred from I and D: – Aggressor — a person where I = YES and D = INITIATING. – Victim — a person where I = YES and D = RECEIVING. – Bystander — a person where I = NO, not physically involved. • A (Aggressive Action): The specific type of aggressive behavior being performed, inferred from the Aggressor’s motions and the Victim’s reactions. For example, ‘punch’, ‘shove’, ‘kick’, ‘choke’, ‘hair grab’. This is determined jointly by the Aggressor and Victim roles.

blocks.en: Here are the causal relationships explained in detail:
blocks.zh: 以下是详细解释的因果关系:

blocks.en: • P → I P\rightarrow I (Does this person interact?): For every person identified in P, ask whether they are physically interacting with another person. This is the first branch point. A person standing and watching is I = NO. A person throwing a punch is I = YES. • I ⁡ ( YES ) → D I(\text{YES})\rightarrow D (What is the direction of their interaction?): For persons with I = YES, determine whether they are initiating or receiving the physical contact.
